changes: First library release for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, on core-ar2 0.7. FILTER TYP turns past PK to BW, a base-width band on the voice's analog filter: FRQ sets the high-pass edge, RES's knob reads WID and sets how far above it the low-pass edge sits, shown in hertz; the FILTER graph draws the band as measured.
stockPolicy: No firmware or stock-derived code/tables are present. Addresses, lengths and SHA-256 guards are metadata; exported instructions and sections are authored module code. Local materialized recipes and firmware are never committed.
